text: You open your laptop and think,

“I'll read my Bible after I
finish this one thing.”
Then a meeting starts.
A deadline moves up,
and the messages keep coming.

Every time you think you'll
get a few minutes,
something else needs your attention.
By the time you close your laptop,
another day is gone.
All you wanted was a moment
to read one Bible verse and reflect on it.
Then one busy day turns into a whole week.
Have you ever felt like work got so busy
that you started drifting away from God?
That's why I built NEAR.

The name stands for New
Encounter and Renewal.
It's a desktop faith companion
that helps you make time for God.
NEAR lives in a little notch
at the top of your screen.

Open NEAR right over what
you're working on.
Your apps stay open,
and today's Bible verse is right there.
Let's take a moment to read a verse
and reflect on it.
Let's start with voice.

If I'm between tasks and
want a moment to pause,
I can talk to NEAR right from my desktop.
I hold N and ask.

If I'm somewhere quiet, I
can type instead.
Here, I'll ask NEAR for a question

I can reflect on after
reading the passage.
I can also open the Bible directly.

I'll pick a passage and press the read-
aloud control.

In the beginning God created
the heavens and the earth.

And the earth was waste and void,
and darkness was upon the face
of the deep.
In Journey, I can create a personal goal
for my walk with God.

I'll set one I can
actually follow this week:

When a passage gives me something I want
to remember,
I can write it down in Notes.

I'll add a short reflection and include
the verse reference.

Later, I can click that reference right
from my note
and open it again.
If I'm already listening to worship music,
I can control it right here in NEAR.
I can pause the song
and pick up where I left off.
[Worship music begins]

Church gives me one place to
see my church activities.

I can open the calendar,
check what's coming up,
and see the details for something
Here's one more thing.

I can start a worship song by
asking NEAR out loud.

Play music, Nothing Is Impossible
by Planetshakers.
[Worship music begins]

Even on a busy day, there's
room for one verse,
a moment to reflect,

or a song that helps you turn your
attention back to God.
That's why I built NEAR.
From Team ANCHOR, thanks for watching.
